title: Frederik Willem Torck's letters from The Hague, Arnhem and elsewhere to Reinhard van Reede (Huis Amerongen), 3 volumes, some in cipher
correspondents: Frederik Willem Torck -> Reinhard van Reede (Amerongen)
shelfmark: Het Utrechts Archief, toegang 1001 Huis Amerongen, inv. nrs. 3486-3488
folio_note: 3486 (1730-33), 3487 (1734-37), 3488 (1738-42); each item note reads "Enkele in cijferschrift" (some in cipher); within 3482-3490 'Brieven afkomstig van regeringspersonen en autoriteiten, 1728-1745'
status: Item notes in the inventory say 'Enkele in cijferschrift' for all three volumes. No scans online (the archive's search shows 'Bekijk gevonden bestanden (0)'). No decipherment mentioned; no edition found.
why: Dutch politics 1730-42 (Orange party, the rise of William IV): three runs of letters with cipher passages from a politician to the head of the Van Reede house. The name Torck appears as the cover sign 'F:F:' in the catalogue's Duncan/Aylva 1730 'groot Chyffer' lead, so that key family may apply.
verify: Order scans of inv. 3486-3488 from Het Utrechts Archief; compare with the Duncan/Aylva 1730 'Extract uit het groot Chyffer' lead in the catalogue.
